root_cause: Prior validation lacked live spawn evidence. The requested live behavior succeeds without a source change.
setup: Marked disposable FM_HOME, separate scratch git repositories, real tmux private socket, installed OpenCode interactive TUI with --standalone. HOME, TMPDIR and all XDG directories isolated in .oc-lab. Seeded a stopped task and invoked real fm-spawn.sh --relaunch to preserve the existing worktree pool; no global provider or credential changes.

scenarios.name: Default restores displaced model
scenarios.assertions: Restored original model, removed managed model marker, preserved agent temperature and read permission; permission wildcard remains allow.

scenarios.name: Tracked project config refusal
scenarios.command: git add -f .opencode/opencode.json; bash bin/fm-spawn.sh oc-live --relaunch --model opencode/space-bunny-free

focused_regressions.selection: Temporary executable driver invoked only four existing test functions, asserting observable fm-spawn behavior. Includes displaced top-level and build-agent values, absence of prior model, permission and effort preservation, and tracked deleted config refusal.

limitations: Initial named package test failed at an unrelated secondmate fixture because its temporary home inside this repository is refused. Four focused OpenCode regressions passed.
Generic fm-control exit reported pending composer text and refused; outside the assigned model scenario. Disposable pane closed through its private tmux socket before replacement.
cleanup: TUIs and private tmux stopped; .oc-lab, isolated OpenCode stores, .oc-socket and .test-tmp removed. Existing fleet and shared service preserved.
